text:
Well done! You reached the goal and managed
to find the Pokémon Research Lab!\c
You did a far sight better than I did my first time.
I’m hopeless with directions.[VAR 0114(0004)]

See how your world has already grown,
all thanks to having Pokémon with you?\c
I know I’m sure glad I’ve got Charizard with me...
to keep me from getting lost all the time.\c
Now, in we go![VAR 0114(0004)]
